newsitem.title: JORDAN: JORDAN BOUGHT 50,000 TONNES U.S. WHEAT AT $178.80.
newsitem.headline: JORDAN BOUGHT 50,000 TONNES U.S. WHEAT AT $178.80.

text.p: Jordan on Tuesday bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter or hard red spring or optional origin wheat for October shipment at $178.80 per tonne on Tuesday, traders said.
They said it was also extending until Thursday the deadline for offers of another 50,000 tonnes and bringing forward the shipment period to second half October from November.
In Tuesday's purchase Jordan bought 50,000 tonnes for October shipment from Continental Grain with optional Argentine, Australian or Canadian wheat, traders said.
A U.S. exporter said earlier Jordan had passed on the 50,000 tonnes it was tendering for November.
